Hi Sam -

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Primary objective: validate performance/latency profile for your HL7 ingestion pipeline and discuss integration points for patient PHI handling and retention policies.
- Suggested next step: 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams (we recommend product architect, ML lead, and SRE) to walk through architecture, sample requests, and a short demo of a live inference run.

Are you available for a deep dive next week? Sam, you mentioned Tuesday/Thursday windows work best. If that still holds, can you share 60-90 minute blocks that include your ML lead (Priya) and infra folks?

I attached a draft agenda for the session - feel free to edit. Proposed agenda highlights:
1) 10m: introductions & goals
2) 20m: high-level architecture and current pain points (Acme)
3) 25m: Redwood runtime deep dive & demo (Dylan)
4) 15m: integration, data/security considerations (Camila)
5) 10m: next steps + mutual action plan

Attachment: redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite with a couple of slots - once you confirm attendees I'll include the right Redwood engineers.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189
